metadata.policy: Every unverified value, blank parcel-specific field, pending SEC filing, and cross-agency methodological divergence is published here with official links for manual review. Unverified items are NEVER fabricated or filled by inference.

items.item: Jack in the Box Inc. FY2026 Full-Year Form 10-K & Q4 FY2026 Results (Fiscal Year Ended Sep 27, 2026)
items.details: As of 2026-11-25, SEC EDGAR contains Q3 FY2026 Form 10-Q (filed Aug 12, 2026) and Form 8-K C-suite departure notice (filed Nov 17, 2026), but FY2026 Form 10-K / Q4 FY2026 earnings release had not yet been filed/indexed. Q4 & FY2026 actual cells remain blank.
items.manualReviewAction: Check SEC EDGAR CIK 0000807882 once FY2026 Form 10-K posts (typically late Nov / early Dec) to confirm final FY2026 SSS, closures, franchise rental revenue, and leverage ratio.

items.item: Private Lease Abstract Terms (Exact Expiration Date in 2030–2035, Rent/NOI, Escalations, Corporate vs. Franchisee Guaranty, Options, Notice Deadlines, Prop 13 Cap, ROFR)
items.details: No confidential lease document exists in this public repository. All lease abstract values are intentionally blank placeholders to protect owner privacy.
items.manualReviewAction: Commission a private attorney-prepared lease abstract offline, reconcile with the notice calendar, and input verified numbers only into the local browser W-02 calculator.

items.item: Exact Central LA Parcel Identity, Municipal Jurisdiction (City of LA vs. Adjacent/Unincorporated), Census Tracts, 1/3/5-Mile Demographics, AADT Traffic & Competitor Ring
items.details: City and County figures are regional proxies only. Exact jurisdiction also determines whether City of LA Measure ULA (4.0% / 5.5% above $5.4M / $10.9M) and LA City Minimum Wage ($18.42/hr) apply.
items.manualReviewAction: Use the confidential APN offline in LA County Assessor Portal, LA City ZIMAS, US Census Geocoder/ACS Tracts, and Caltrans/LADOT traffic portals; record only anonymized tract summaries if sharing externally.

items.item: Parcel-Level Earthquake Fault/Liquefaction (CGS EQ Zapp), Flood Zone (FEMA FIRM), Fire Hazard Severity Zone (CAL FIRE 2025 LRA), Insurance Policy & Phase I ESA
items.details: Regional LA hazard statistics are verified, but parcel-specific regulatory zone status cannot be confirmed without the confidential APN/address.
items.manualReviewAction: Run offline parcel lookups in CGS EQ Zapp, FEMA MSC, and CAL FIRE 2025 LRA FHSZ viewer; order confidential Phase I ESA, PCA, and commercial insurance quote review.

items.item: Real Market Cap Rates, Short-Lease Discount Spreads & Comparable Central LA QSR Sales
items.details: Official government sources do not publish parcel-level QSR NNN cap rates or short-lease discounts. Verified U.S. Treasury 10-Yr yield (4.91% on Nov 24, 2026) serves only as the risk-free floor.
items.manualReviewAction: Obtain 3 written Broker Opinions of Value (BOVs) pricing BOTH current remaining WALT and a hypothetical 10–15 yr blend-and-extend, plus verified Central LA QSR & land comps, then enter into W-02.

items.item: Owner Adjusted Tax Basis, Cumulative Sec. 1250 Depreciation, Existing Mortgage/Prepayment Penalty, Entity Form & Estate Plan
items.details: Statutory federal, CA, LA County, and Measure ULA tax rules are verified, but actual net after-tax proceeds cannot be determined without owner's private tax return basis and debt payoff statement.
items.manualReviewAction: Have CPA compute verified adjusted basis, unrecaptured Sec. 1250 depreciation, CA/federal effective rates, and Prop 19 estate impact offline before comparing sell vs. 1031 vs. hold.

items.item: LA County & City Population Estimate Divergence (U.S. Census V2025 vs. CA DOF Jan 2026 E-1)
items.currentStatus: FLAGGED — DIFFERENT DATES / METHODS; DO NOT COMPARE DIRECTLY
items.details: Current QuickFacts shows July 1, 2025 V2025 population of 9,694,934 for LA County and 3,869,089 for LA City. CA DOF E-1 shows Jan 1, 2026 values of 9,837,286 (-0.6% YoY) and 3,806,201 (-0.9% YoY), respectively. These dates and estimation methods differ; CA DOF explicitly says the series generally should not be compared directly. Keep the series separate and do not treat their difference as a same-date discrepancy.
items.manualReviewAction: For trend work, select one official series and retain its vintage/date consistently; record the other series only as contextual cross-check, with CA DOF’s comparability warning.

items.item: BLS October 2026 LA-Long Beach-Anaheim CPI-U 12-Month Percent Change Blank
items.details: BLS CPI Overview Table (Nov 2026) reports Oct 2026 LA index at 360.965 (+0.6% MoM) and Sep 2026 12-month change at +3.7%, but leaves Oct 2025->Oct 2026 12-month % change blank ('-') because Oct 2025 data was unpublished.
items.manualReviewAction: Use verified Sep 2026 (+3.7% YoY) and verify Nov/Dec 2026 BLS releases when published; do not interpolate missing BLS official cells.

items.item: Q1 FY2026 Gross Openings/Closures Split & Q2 FY2026 Company/Franchise SSS Sub-Split
items.details: Q1 FY2026 ending units (2,128, net -8) and Q2 FY2026 system SSS (-3.8%) and openings/closures (9 opened, 9 closed) are verified; exact Q1 gross open/close split and Q2 company-vs-franchise SSS & rental revenue sub-lines were not reproduced in summary excerpts and are left blank rather than inferred.
items.manualReviewAction: Manually verify full Q1 FY2026 (jack-20260118.htm) and Q2 FY2026 (jack-20260412.htm) 10-Q tables on SEC EDGAR if quarterly sub-splits are required.

items.item: Jack in the Box Inc. Del Taco Discontinued Operations Recast (Dec 22, 2025 Sale)
items.details: FY2023–FY2025 consolidated revenue totals in FY2025 10-K included Del Taco, while FY2026 10-Qs moved Del Taco to Discontinued Operations. All figures in our Tenant Analysis table are isolated to the standalone Jack in the Box segment for apples-to-apples continuity.
items.manualReviewAction: When reviewing third-party broker OMs or financial aggregators, confirm they are not mixing pre-divestiture consolidated revenues with post-divestiture standalone Jack in the Box revenues.

items.item: LAUSD Enrollment Count — CDE District Profile vs California School Dashboard
items.currentStatus: FLAGGED — DO NOT PUBLISH AN ENROLLMENT VALUE UNTIL RECONCILED
items.details: The CDE LAUSD district profile reports enrollment of 497,105 for 2025–26, while the 2025 California School Dashboard reports 369,830. The periods and/or enrollment definitions differ; this dashboard does not determine which population is comparable. The W-01 enrollment cell is therefore explicitly unresolved. The separate 2024–25 graduation-rate figure is not an enrollment count.
items.manualReviewAction: Ask CDE/LAUSD to identify the precise reporting date, student-population definition, and coverage behind each value; then select one consistently defined series. Keep parcel school assignment separate and verify it offline.
